title: Q16
description:
“Till I make Your enemies Your footstool.”
Read: Psa 110:1–2, 5–6, Heb 10:12–13
a) In the psalm the enthroned Lord rules “in the midst of Your enemies” and later “He shall judge among the nations” (v. 6). What does that bring forward about what remains unfinished after the seating of Heb 1:3?
